title: FaithRunners AI Art Prompt
description: Schema for every AI-generated art prompt file in this game. One file = one asset (a hero, a map, a sprite/VFX, or a UI piece). Keeping every asset on this shape means a generation script can walk the folders and batch-render without per-asset special-casing.

asset_type.description: character = a hero's static poses/portrait. scenario = a map's tileset/background/hazard. sprite = a standalone animated effect not tied to a character pose (ability VFX, hazard animation loops). ui = HUD/menu/meta art.

id.description: Stable identifier, matches the Dart model id where one exists (e.g. RunnerHero.id, RaceMap.id).

story_ref.description: Scripture reference this asset is grounded in, e.g. '1 Samuel 17'. Omit for pure-UI assets.

style_guide_ref.description: Points at style_guide.json's 'id' field. Every generation tool call should prepend that file's 'art_style' and 'negative_prompt' to each variant's prompt text.

variant_id.description: e.g. idle, run_cycle_4_frames, ability_pose, portrait, tileset_ground, hazard_animation, hud_icon.

output_kind.description: Tells the generation tool/pipeline how to post-process the output (e.g. slice a sprite_sheet into frames, tile-test a seamless_tile).
